# A temporary is rejected when the vector loop would not match the scalar loop:
# a local that the code after the loop reads or the function returns, a local
# read before the loop assigns it (carried from the previous iteration), a
# scalar the loop reassigns, a second assignment to one temporary, and a
# temporary of another element type.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func UsedAfter(a, b []float32) float32 {
	var s float32
	for i := range a {
		s = b[i] + 1
		a[i] = s * s
	}
	return s
}

func NamedResult(a, b []float32) (s float32) {
	for i := range a {
		s = b[i] + 1
		a[i] = s * s
	}
	return
}

func Carried(a, b []float32) {
	var s float32
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = s * b[i]
		s = b[i]
	}
}

func Reassigned(a, b []float32, k float32) {
	for i := range a {
		a[i] = b[i] * k
		k = b[i]
	}
}

func Twice(a, b []float32) {
	for i := range a {
		s := b[i] + 1
		s = s * 2
		a[i] = s
	}
}

func OtherType(a []float32, b []int32) {
	for i := range a {
		s := b[i] + 1
		a[i] = 2
		b[i] = s
	}
}
